title: Add Captions to LinkedIn Videos
metaDescription: Add clean, professional captions to LinkedIn videos: automatic transcript, calm caption styles, and an MP4 in 1:1, 16:9 or 4:5 for the feed.
intro: Videos in a professional feed often play without sound. Supertitle adds clean, readable captions to talks, demos and announcements, and exports the MP4 in a shape that suits the feed, such as square or widescreen.
summary: Calm, readable captions for talks, demos and announcements.

safeZone.description: In the feed, LinkedIn shows video with its own player controls and the post text around it. Supertitle's Safe zones guide is drawn for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, so it isn't a map of LinkedIn's interface. For feed videos, the Bottom position keeps captions low in the frame and away from faces; preview the post before you publish to check nothing covers them.

faq.question: Which format should I export for LinkedIn?
faq.answer: Supertitle exports as uploaded or cropped to 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 or 9:16. Square and widescreen are common choices for the feed.

faq.question: Which style looks most professional?
faq.answer: Classic, with text on a dark bar, or Minimal, a serif face with a soft shadow. Both stay out of the way of what you're saying.

faq.question: Can I caption a webinar recording?
faq.answer: Yes, up to {plan.pro.maxVideoMinutes} minutes on {plan.pro.name} ({plan.creator.maxVideoMinutes} on {plan.creator.name}, {plan.free.maxVideoMinutes} on {plan.free.name}). Trim the start and the end to keep only the part you want to share.
